hypotheses.title: Non-Linear Conviction Sharpening and Multi-Domain Alpha Elevation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Traditional linear rank expressions allocate significant capital to noisy middle-decile securities that carry low information coefficient (IC). Applying quadratic power transformation (signed_power(group_rank(...) - 0.5, 2)) compresses neutral percentiles to near-zero allocation while doubling capital deployment to extreme high-conviction winners and losers. Combining this conviction sharpening across three orthogonal domains (analyst consensus forward EPS yield, 100% coverage operational cashflow efficiency derivatives, and options downside put breakeven support floors) with a 15% 3-day price reversal stabilizer optimizes turnover into the 11%-13% sweet spot, directly maximizing the WorldQuant BRAIN Fitness multiplier to achieve EXCELLENT (Fitness >= 1.80) and SPECTACULAR (Fitness >= 2.20) ratings.
hypotheses.falsification_test: The hypothesis fails if quadratic conviction scaling amplifies tail risk instead of return density, or if subindustry neutralization fails to insulate against sector-level rotation shocks.
